joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: All original STORE/LOAD prepare, submission, completion and release paths unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; every request completes1024 output tokens ignoring EOS.

fixed.admission: Native request priority and waiting order retained. Candidate may return one native-loop break immediately before an eligible waiting allocation; it does not move, pop or skip a waiting request.
fixed.B_GC_OBSERVATION: identical passive callbacks in all four cells
fixed.recovery_fit_or_repeat: No fit_once, repeat or retry-defer policy remains installed during service; true native baseline. The yield policy may reuse pinned qualification/compiler helpers without installing their service policy.
fixed.observations: Identical compact output capture, native completion/order/allocation/source observers, passive GC callbacks and recovery-start-yield evidence in both arms.
fixed.B_RECOVERY_START_YIELD: native/yield_once according to fixed ABBA; sole policy variable

selection: Native/yield_once/yield_once/native with unchanged fixed256x1024 workload, external arrivals, compact capture and passive GC. Probe one native waiting-allocation boundary when an earlier LOAD is registered but not ACKed and a later recovery would start with zero external tokens. At most one actual policy break per whole cell.
scope: Exploratory bounded action probe. Test whether one-round postponement of later zero-external recovery permits earlier LOAD completion to become usable without post-ACK token-budget obstruction. It is not a retry-defer gate, hard dependency, or confirmation of earlier policies.

intervention.native: Original waiting allocation and retry behavior with the same opportunity observations; no policy break.
intervention.yield_once: At an eligible original waiting allocation boundary, execute one native break. The next schedule entry returns to native behavior; no 500ms gate, added dependency, queue move, in-flight cancellation, transfer priority or ownership change.

primary_readout: Verify legal opportunity, actual break and next-entry pass with request/task joins; all-request TTFT, completion, maximum generation gap, output throughput and fixed joint SLO. Retain failures/timeouts/unfinished, copy/output work, per-request cumulative recovery union, common GC intervals, post-observation materialization and phase times separately. One-round break does not establish request benefit.
stop_rule: Planned native/yield_once/yield_once/native. If first yield_once action_count==0 or executed_breaks==0, stop before both reverse cells with explicit STOP_NO_ACTION, retain all collected raws and release the group lock. Missing action evidence aborts explicitly. Otherwise finish one fixed ABBA. No automatic parameter sweep or repeated submissions; different-run events are not matched-state controls.

resource_checks.disk_check_scope: Session/cache filesystem once after acquiring whole-group lock, before first warmup; no per-cell threshold. Source/model unchanged.
resource_checks.disk_basis: Same-shape completed storage ABBA raw582171305B + caches324943122B + archive31726832B < 1GB; require3GiB before group, leaving >2GiB beyond measured group footprint. Original4GiB was a conservative runner check, not a hardware budget or experimental variable.

storage_note: This session and its independent empty caches use /tmp. Model/source retain existing locations. Once-held-lock group-prelaunch 3GiB floor and output isolation are unchanged; this preparation performs no cleanup or deployment.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap is a common diagnostic, not a storage intervention in this group; callback intervals do not prove pure CPU pause cost or recovery-policy causation.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Reuse the retained original runtime/package and model cache. This local plan preparation performs no deployment, model initialization or GPU run.
deployment.comparison_scope: All arms, if launched, run contemporaneously under one shared whole-group GPU lock. No historical raw is a performance control; early-stop retains all collected cells.

source_basis: Direct frozen source_handoff native cell and fixed termination transform; common compact capture/passive GC. Reuse the frozen retry group controller only for lock/resource/zero-action-stop behavior, with actual recovery-start-yield mode/artifact namespace and new local child runner. No old policy runner is installed; all parent files stay unchanged.
